title: Adding the next prefix coordinate
statement: Let $n$ and $k$ be natural numbers with $k<n$. The coordinates of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ with index less than $k+1$ are the union of the coordinates with index less than $k$ and the coordinate $k$.
